integrity_notes: The infinite theorem has an analytic proof; the exact-rational checker certifies one smooth example and algebraic sharpness but does not replace that proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed. The exterior first-order displacement is obtained analytically from monomial moments.
scientific_limitations: The radius is the optimal uniform guarantee over radial probability measures, not a classification of the zero set for each fixed measure.
The normalization of both measures is needed for the numerical threshold 1. The theorem assumes positive Hardy mass and radial measures supported inside the disk.
It gives no nonradial theorem. Published-priority comparisons are not exhaustive.
title: Sharp universal zero-free radius for Hardy-regularized radial Bergman kernels
